metaDescription: Turn selected PDF pages 90, 180 or 270 degrees clockwise and download the full document.
intro: Turn selected PDF pages 90, 180 or 270 degrees clockwise and download the full document.
aboutTitle: What happens to pages I leave unselected?
about: Only the pages you enter receive the chosen rotation. The download contains the full document, including the other pages in their existing orientation.
exampleTitle: Fix a sideways page in a report
example: Select the PDF, enter the affected page number and choose 90 degrees clockwise. Open the saved file and check that page before sharing.

faqs.question: Can I rotate several pages at once?
faqs.answer: Yes. Enter individual numbers and ranges together, such as 2, 5-7, then choose a single angle for that selection.
